project.name: AION
project.tagline: Artificial Intelligence Operating Nervous System — specialized AI agents collaborating as one system
project.architecture: Monorepo: apps/api (FastAPI + agent orchestration) and apps/web (Next.js App Router + Tailwind + shadcn-style UI)
project.phase: Phase 3 — AION orchestration (chat routing, cognitive bus, deterministic confidence)

verification_snapshot.docker: docker-compose.yml + 2 Dockerfiles present (not exercised in this run)

harness_scores.verdict: Strong local verification loop, missing enforcement layer
harness_scores.derivation: Holistic, verification-weighted judgment of what exists today (arithmetic mean of the eight dimensions is 5.6; the zero CI dimension is a categorical absence rather than poor quality, so the mean understates the working local loop)

strengths.title: Secret-free deterministic test loop
strengths.evidence: apps/api/tests/conftest.py forces AION_DISABLE_MODEL_CALLS=1 and shims sys.path; all 16 tests pass in 1.37s with no API keys and no network
strengths.impact: Any agent or contributor can self-verify backend changes instantly, without credentials or flaky external calls

strengths.title: Dependency injection makes failure paths testable
strengths.evidence: WorkflowRunner accepts an agents dict; tests inject FailingPlanner and RejectingCritic fakes to assert agent-failure safety, single-retry critic limits, and exact confidence math (0.82)
strengths.impact: Error handling and scoring are contract-tested, not just happy paths — regressions in safety behavior get caught

strengths.title: Graceful degradation instead of crashes
strengths.evidence: GeminiService.generate returns None when unconfigured or on HTTP/parsing errors; BaseAgent.fallback produces a development-mode response; responses surface development_mode explicitly
strengths.impact: The system runs end-to-end with zero credentials, and model outages degrade to clearly marked dev-mode output

strengths.title: README doubles as a bootstrap contract
strengths.evidence: README.md documents setup for both apps, env variables, API route table, chat routing rules, the confidence formula, and current phase status
strengths.impact: A fresh agent or human can orient and start working without asking questions

strengths.title: Strict static gates on the frontend
strengths.evidence: package.json scripts run eslint . --max-warnings=0 and tsc --noEmit; both exit 0 on the current tree
strengths.impact: Zero-warning policy keeps the codebase from drifting into unenforceable lint debt

strengths.title: Clean environment-variable hygiene
strengths.evidence: Three .env.example files (root, apps/api, apps/web) contain safe placeholders only; .gitignore excludes .env variants while negating !.env.example
strengths.impact: Secrets never enter history; required configuration is discoverable at every level

strengths.title: Safe error surfaces, tested for leak prevention
strengths.evidence: main.py installs a global exception handler returning a generic 500; test_agent_failure_returns_safe_aion_error asserts internal detail ('simulated') never reaches the user-facing answer
strengths.impact: Internal failures cannot leak stack traces or provider details to clients

strengths.title: Bounded, pinned dependencies
strengths.evidence: requirements.txt uses >=x,<major ranges for all six packages; Dockerfiles pin python:3.13-slim and node:22-alpine with a multi-stage standalone web build
strengths.impact: Rebuilds stay reproducible and surprise major-version upgrades are blocked

gaps.title: No CI pipeline at all
gaps.evidence: No .github/workflows, no other CI config anywhere in the repo; pytest/lint/typecheck gates exist only as local knowledge
gaps.impact: Nothing enforces the green state this project already achieves locally; one bad merge can silently break the loop
gaps.fix: Add a ~30-line GitHub Actions workflow running pytest in apps/api and npm ci + lint + typecheck + build in apps/web on push/PR

gaps.title: No agent convention file
gaps.evidence: No AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or .cursorrules; the cwd requirement (pytest must run from apps/api because conftest shims sys.path) and the AION_DISABLE_MODEL_CALLS flag are only discoverable by reading conftest.py
gaps.impact: AI assistants rediscover project rules by trial and error, wasting turns and risking wrong commands
gaps.fix: Add a root AGENTS.md listing the interpreter path (.venv), where to run each command, and the dev-mode flag

gaps.title: Frontend has zero behavioral tests
gaps.evidence: No Vitest/Jest/Playwright setup; README honestly lists testing as 'ESLint, TypeScript, and Pytest'; the in-progress alert/ feature is unverifiable beyond static checks
gaps.impact: UI regressions (routing, chat roundtrip, mode switching) ship undetected
gaps.fix: Add Playwright smoke tests for the 8 pages plus one chat roundtrip against the dev-mode API

gaps.title: docker-compose wires the example env, not real env
gaps.evidence: docker-compose.yml api service uses env_file: ./apps/api/.env.example; no healthchecks on either service
gaps.impact: Compose always runs in dev-mode with no Gemini key, and containers have no readiness gating
gaps.fix: Point env_file at apps/api/.env with documented fallback, and add healthchecks (curl /health, wget /)

gaps.title: Repo hygiene drift
gaps.evidence: 3 of 5 commits share the message 'Development Commands'; working tree holds 3 modified files and an untracked apps/web/app/alert/ feature
gaps.impact: Low-signal history and uncommitted work make bisecting and agent navigation via git unreliable
gaps.fix: Commit or stash WIP, and adopt conventional commits (feat/fix/chore) for future changes

gaps.title: No single verification entrypoint
gaps.evidence: Verification requires chaining commands from two README sections across two directories; no Makefile/justfile/root script
gaps.impact: Multi-step verification invites skipped steps, especially for automated agents
gaps.fix: Add a root make check (or npm script) chaining backend pytest + frontend lint/typecheck/build

gaps.title: Runtime version drift between local and container
gaps.evidence: Local .venv is Python 3.14 while the API Dockerfile pins python:3.13-slim; pytest also emits a Starlette TestClient deprecation warning (httpx/httpx2 transition)
gaps.impact: Code verified locally on 3.14 may behave differently in the 3.13 container; deprecation signals a coming break
gaps.fix: Align .venv and Dockerfile on one Python minor version and plan the httpx2 migration

gaps.title: Test dependencies mixed into runtime requirements
gaps.evidence: requirements.txt ships pytest alongside fastapi/uvicorn/pydantic for production images
gaps.impact: Production containers carry test tooling; dependency intent is blurred
gaps.fix: Split into requirements.txt + requirements-dev.txt (httpx stays runtime-adjacent for TestClient only in dev)

top_recommendations: Add a minimal GitHub Actions CI matrix: pytest (apps/api) and lint+typecheck+build (apps/web) — highest leverage, the local loop already proves it will pass
Write a root AGENTS.md capturing interpreter path, per-app working directories, and the AION_DISABLE_MODEL_CALLS dev-mode flag
Create a one-command check entrypoint (make check) that chains every gate in the right directory
Introduce Playwright smoke coverage for the 8 routes and one chat roundtrip before the UI surface grows further
Fix compose env wiring (.env with fallback + healthchecks) and switch to conventional commit messages
